body:
I had been experimenting for a couple months with softer drugs, and one night I decided I wanted to buy some Cocaine. So we went to make the purchase. A friend of mine went inside to get the Meth as I waited in the car. As soon as I got my bag of 'Coke' we went directly to my house to have some fun. Before he went inside I told him I wanted freebase snow. I assumed he knew what that meant but when I looked at the bag I said it looked more like Ice. He said that's because it is. He made a mistake and apologized. I didn't want to do this drug because of the stories I heard and the way media portrayed it. I decided why not and we proceeded to smoke at 11PM.
T+ 0:05 I took one HUGE hit and I thought I was going to go crazy... But nothing happened, besides a raise in my heart rate. I was really surprised.
I thought I was going to go crazy... But nothing happened, besides a raise in my heart rate. I was really surprised.
So I kept hitting it for a total of seven hits.
T+ 0:15 I didn't feel rushed or anything of the sort. I felt very focused and happy. Complete bliss. We decided to pop Super Mario Bros. Into the Wii.
T+ 1:00 We were still going hard on Mario Bros. I was thirsty as kept drinking water so I wouldn't get sick. I still had felt very content and happy. I could not believe how people thought it was so horrible. I mean if you think about it America has millions of little speed freaks on Amphetamines!
T+ 3:00 At this point we were still feeling the effects
3:15AM I decided to take 7 more hits.
T+ 5:00 I starting to get hungry and my friend who had more experience with Methamphetamine said there was no way I could eat and he was surprised as Meth suppresses the desire to eat. I went upstairs and proceeded to eat a whole sandwich. It felt as if it was hard to chew but I was glad to eat something. And then my friends left.
T+ 7:00 I decided to lay down fore a bit. Then my mother came home and I didn't know if I should talk to her but I was very calm and had a conversation with her as if I was not high. So now I am trying to go to bed at around 7:30AM Basically the whole day I forced myself to fall asleep but I kept waking up every hour on the hour and finally fell asleep for good sometime late that afternoon.
Summary: I was surprised that it was a crazy trip. I was just very happy and felt complete bliss after I took my hits, and liked talking a lot. It was almost impossible to fall asleep. I told myself I'd never try Meth, but the opportunity arose and I took it. It is something I would do again, but I don't see how someone could get addicted. I have very amazing self-control but some people do not.
